jobs.title: PRADA Retail Support (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Founded in 1913 in Italy, the Prada Group was built on a tradition of excellence and with a vision of innovation. The Group, a world leader in the luxury sector, operates in more than 45 countries with the PRADA, Miu Miu, Versace, Church’s, Car Shoe and Luna Rossa brands, and has employees of over 100 nationalities.

JOB DETAILS

We are seeking a passionate and dedicated Retail Support (m/f/d) for max. 20h/week to support our Sales Team in our PRADA Outlet Store in Metzingen. You will be responsible to help the sales team in all aspects of the store and stock activities. To be part of a team and helping with every-day activities by ensuring customer satisfaction.

At PRADA, we are renowned for our unwavering commitment to luxury, style, and innovation. As one of the global leaders in the fashion industry, we are dedicated to delivering exceptional experiences to our esteemed clientele. Our brand represents a fusion of tradition and modernity, and our Client Advisors play a pivotal role in providing personalized service and creating memorable moments for our discerning customers.

RESPONSABILITIES

• Welcome and serve the customer always providing an excellent in-store experience.

• Support the team in all aspects of the Store.

• Maintain goods from the warehouse and to process orders from the Sales team.

KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS

Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to connect with a diverse clientele.

Passion for luxury fashion trends, and an understanding of the luxury retail market.

Fluent spoken German and English expected.

Joining our Company means working in a creative and international environment, with teams of people motivated by curiosity and the quest for excellence. The engine of our success is the importance and value that we place on the talent and passion of our people leading to their own professional growth.
 Prada Group promotes an inclusive work environment, ensuring equal opportunities for all candidates, regardless of gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, disability, or other personal characteristics. We believe that diversity is a value and we are committed to build a fair and respectful workplace for all.

jobs.title: Stock Assistant
jobs.description:
Founded in 1913 in Italy, the Prada Group was built on a tradition of excellence and with a vision of innovation. The Group, a world leader in the luxury sector, operates in more than 45 countries with the PRADA, Miu Miu, Versace, Church’s, Car Shoe and Luna Rossa brands, and has employees of over 100 nationalities.

JOB PURPOSE

You support the Stock Manager in all the responsibilities related to the warehouse management and in providing services to the Store.

You ensure the correct handling of goods in store, complying with the KPI’s and guidelines and company procedures for the care of the product.

RESPONSIBILITIES

• Ensure the care and protection of the product according to company guidelines

• Day-to-day management of goods receipt and storage in line with company

procedures and criteria, preparing products to be brought to the sales floor and

in special areas while optimizing the timing efficiency

• Prepare shop-to-shop and returns transfers in compliance with company

guidelines and timelines

• Prepare the flow of E-Commerce orders (Prada.com or e-Tailers) making sure to

• guarantee the required service levels

• Prepare the flow of the damaged products, not sellable product (On Hold,

Consignment ...), products under repair

• Organizes the Packaging and Stationery physically and on the IT systems

• Organizes the Display objects system

• Ensure that the company guidelines are adopted in the event of theft, especially

in terms of communication and documentation produced

• Support in the prompt investigation in the event of system negatives

• Participate in the organization and execution of the Physical and Cycle

Inventories of the finished product and accessory locations (packaging /

stationery and Engineering materials) respecting the company timing

• Support the management of the warehouse activities related to sales

• Ensure security and cleanliness of the warehouse

KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS

Fluent spoken English expected.

High sense of responsibility.

Being able to work in team as well as alone.

Organized and detail oriented.

Joining our Company means working in a creative and international environment, with teams of people motivated by curiosity and the quest for excellence. The engine of our success is the importance and value that we place on the talent and passion of our people leading to their own professional growth.

We believe that diversity is a value and we are committed to build a fair and respectful workplace for all.

jobs.title: PRADA, Stock Manager, Sawgrass Outlet

titleByLocale.fr: PRADA, gestionnaire des stocks, Sawgrass Outlet

jobs.description:
Founded in 1913 in Italy, the Prada Group was built on a tradition of excellence and with a vision of innovation. The Group, a world leader in the luxury sector, operates in more than 45 countries with the PRADA, Miu Miu, Versace, Church’s, Car Shoe and Luna Rossa brands, and has employees of over 100 nationalities.

JOB PURPOSE

To be responsible of stock management in terms of KPIs, Corporate guidelines and procedures. To manage the stock team in order to facilitate the selling process through an impeccable stock maintenance and to be accountable of minimizing the stock losses. To ensure the implementation of all guidelines received from the Store Operations Department and Store Manager.

RESPONSIBILITIES

• Ensure the safety of the products and the valuable material in the warehouse during the whole handling process.

• Ensure to properly manage the daily goods receipt, to arrange the merchandise following the corporate procedures and prepare the product to be taken on the shop floor and special areas.

• Organize, manage and perform the products’ counting and the stock takes.

• Assure the right product flow tracking through SAP system.

• Manage the stockroom activities related to Markdown.

• Guarantee the returns, shop-to-shop transfers, and e-commerce delivery following the corporate guidelines and deadlines.

• Ensure the security and cleaning of the stock facility.

• Optimize and organize the space available of all stockroom areas (cooperating with the Store Manager and the Store Operations Manager).

• Train, manage and evaluate the stock team.

• Coordinate and plan the staff’s activities, distributing the tasks and the responsibilities.

• Manage the assigned team through a constant training and coaching.

• Manage performance assessment interviews with the staff in accordance with Store Manager.

KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS

• Leadership and team management

• Ability to motivate

• Organized and detail oriented

• Mature and assertive

• Business/Retail Management degree or equivalent is a plus

• Interest in luxury/fashion, art and design

• English is a must other languages are a plus

descriptionByLocale.it:
Fondato nel 1913 in Italia, il Gruppo Prada è stato costruito su una tradizione di eccellenza e con una visione dell'innovazione. Il Gruppo, leader mondiale nel settore del lusso, opera in oltre 45 paesi con i marchi PRADA, Miu Miu, Versace, Church’s, Car Shoe e Luna Rossa, e ha dipendenti di oltre 100 nazionalità.

JOB PURPOSE

Essere responsabile della gestione delle scorte in termini di KPI, linee guida e procedure aziendali. Gestire il team azionario al fine di facilitare il processo di vendita attraverso una manutenzione impeccabile delle scorte e di essere responsabile di ridurre al minimo le perdite di magazzino. Per garantire l'implementazione di tutte le linee guida ricevute dal Dipartimento Operazioni Store e Store Manager.

RISPOSIZIONI

• Assicurare la sicurezza dei prodotti e il materiale prezioso nel magazzino durante l'intero processo di movimentazione.

• Assicurarsi di gestire correttamente la ricevuta della merce quotidiana, organizzare la merce seguendo le procedure aziendali e preparare il prodotto da prendere sul piano del negozio e aree speciali.

• Organizzare, gestire ed eseguire il conteggio dei prodotti e lo stock prende.

• Assicurare il corretto monitoraggio del flusso del prodotto attraverso il sistema SAP.

• Gestire le attività di magazzino relative a Markdown.

• Garantire i rendimenti, i trasferimenti da negozio a negozio e la consegna di e-commerce seguendo le linee guida e le scadenze aziendali.

• Assicurare la sicurezza e la pulizia del magazzino.

• Ottimizzare e organizzare lo spazio disponibile di tutte le aree di magazzino (cooperando con Store Manager e Store Operations Manager).

• Allena, gestisci e valuta il team azionario.

• Coordinare e pianificare le attività del personale, distribuendo i compiti e le responsabilità.

• Gestire il team assegnato attraverso una formazione costante e coaching.

• Gestisci le interviste di valutazione delle prestazioni con il personale in conformità con Store Manager.

CONOSCENZA E SKILLS

• Leadership e gestione del team

• Capacità di motivare

• Organizzata e orientata al dettaglio

• Matura e assertiva

• Business/Retail Management Grado o equivalente è un plus

• Interessi di lusso/fashion, arte e design

• Inglese è un must altre lingue sono un plus

descriptionByLocale.de:
Die 1913 in Italien gegründete Prada Group basiert auf einer Tradition der Exzellenz und mit einer Vision der Innovation. Die Gruppe, ein weltweit führendes Unternehmen im Luxussektor, ist in mehr als 45 Ländern mit den Marken PRADA, Miu Miu, Versace, Church’s, Car Shoe und Luna Rossa tätig und beschäftigt über 100 Nationalitäten.

GEMEINSAMER ZWECK

Verantwortung für die Bestandsverwaltung in Bezug auf KPIs, Unternehmensrichtlinien und -verfahren. Um das Lagerteam zu verwalten, um den Verkaufsprozess durch eine tadellose Lagerhaltung zu erleichtern und zur Minimierung der Aktienverluste verantwortlich zu sein. Um die Umsetzung aller Richtlinien zu gewährleisten, die vom Store Operations Department und Store Manager erhalten wurden.

VERANTWORTUNGEN

• Gewährleistung der Sicherheit der Produkte und des wertvollen Materials im Lager während des gesamten Handhabungsprozesses.

• Stellen Sie sicher, dass Sie den täglichen Wareneingang ordnungsgemäß verwalten, die Waren nach den Unternehmensabläufen arrangieren und das Produkt vorbereiten, um es in der Werkstatt und in speziellen Bereichen zu nehmen.

• Organisieren, verwalten und führen Sie die Produktzählung und die Bestandsaufnahmen durch.

• Sichern Sie sich die richtige Produktflussverfolgung über das SAP-System.

• Verwalten Sie die Lageraktivitäten im Zusammenhang mit Markdown.

• Garantieren Sie die Rücksendungen, Shop-to-Shop-Transfers und E-Commerce-Lieferung nach den Unternehmensrichtlinien und Fristen.

• Gewährleistung der Sicherheit und Reinigung der Bestandsanlage.

• Optimieren und organisieren Sie den verfügbaren Platz aller Lagerräume (in Zusammenarbeit mit dem Store Manager und dem Store Operations Manager).

• Trainieren, verwalten und bewerten Sie das Lagerteam.

• Koordinieren und planen Sie die Aktivitäten des Personals und verteilen Sie die Aufgaben und Verantwortlichkeiten.

• Verwalten Sie das zugewiesene Team durch ein ständiges Training und Coaching.

• Verwalten Sie Performance Assessment Interviews mit den Mitarbeitern in Übereinstimmung mit Store Manager.

KENNTNIS UND FÄHIGKEITEN

• Führung und Teammanagement

• Fähigkeit zur Motivation

• Organisiert und detailorientiert

• Reife und durchsetzungsfähig

• Business / Retail Management Grad oder gleichwertig ist ein Plus

• Interesse an Luxus/Mode, Kunst und Design

• Englisch ist ein Muss andere Sprachen sind ein Plus
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Fondé en 1913 en Italie, le groupe Prada s'appuie sur une tradition d'excellence et une vision d'innovation. Le Groupe, leader mondial du secteur du luxe, opère dans plus de 45 pays avec les marques PRADA, Miu Miu, Versace, Church, Car Shoe et Luna Rossa et compte plus de 100 employés de nationalités.

BUT DE L'EMPLOI

Être responsable de la gestion des stocks en termes d'ICP, de lignes directrices et de procédures de l'entreprise. Gérer l'équipe des stocks afin de faciliter le processus de vente par un entretien impeccable des stocks et d'être responsable de minimiser les pertes des stocks. Assurer la mise en oeuvre de toutes les lignes directrices reçues du Département des opérations de magasin et du Gestionnaire de magasin.

RESPONSABLES

• Assurer la sécurité des produits et du matériel précieux dans l'entrepôt pendant tout le processus de manutention.

• Veiller à bien gérer la réception quotidienne des marchandises, à organiser la marchandise selon les procédures de l'entreprise et à préparer le produit à emporter au magasin et dans des zones spéciales.

• Organisez, gérez et exécutez les produits en comptant et le stock prend.

• Assure le bon suivi du flux de produits via le système SAP.

• Gérer les activités de magasin liées à Markdown.

• Garantir les retours, les transferts de magasin à magasin et la livraison du commerce électronique selon les directives et les délais de l'entreprise.

• Assurer la sécurité et le nettoyage des stocks.

• Optimiser et organiser l'espace disponible dans toutes les zones de stockage (coopérer avec le responsable des magasins et le responsable des opérations des magasins).

• Former, gérer et évaluer l'équipe des stocks.

• Coordonner et planifier les activités du personnel, répartir les tâches et les responsabilités.

• Gérer l'équipe assignée par une formation et un encadrement constants.

• Gérer les entrevues d'évaluation du rendement avec le personnel conformément à Store Manager.

CONNAISSANCES ET COMPÉTENCES

• Leadership et gestion d'équipe

• Aptitude à motiver

• Organisation et détail

• Mûr et affirmé

• Un diplôme de gestion d'entreprise/de détail ou équivalent est un plus

• Intérêt pour le luxe / mode, l'art et le design

• L'anglais est un must autres langues sont un plus
